exam: 2022年6月 第2套 · 仔细阅读 P2
title: In the coming era of budget cuts to education, distance lear…

sents.en: In the coming era of budget cuts to education, distance learning could become the norm.
sents.cn: 在即将到来的教育预算削减时代，远程学习可能成为常态。

sents.en: The temptation for those in charge of education budgets to trade teachers for technology could be so strong that they ignore the disadvantages of distance learning.
sents.cn: 那些掌管教育预算的人，用技术替代教师的诱惑可能如此强烈，以至于他们忽视了远程学习的弊端。

sents.en: School facilities are expensive to build and maintain, and teachers are expensive to employ.
sents.cn: 校舍建造与维护昂贵，雇佣教师也昂贵。

sents.en: Online classes do not require buildings and each class can host hundreds of people simultaneously, resulting in greater savings, thus increasing the temptation of distance education for those concerned more about budgets than learning.
sents.cn: 在线课程不需要校舍，且每个班可同时容纳数百人，从而节省更多开支，这进一步增加了那些更关心预算而非学习之人对远程教育的诱惑。

sents.en: But moving away from a traditional classroom in which a living, breathing human being teaches and interacts with students daily would be a disaster.
sents.cn: 但离开传统课堂——一个活生生的、会呼吸的人每天教导并与学生互动的课堂——将是一场灾难。

sents.en: Physically attending school has hidden benefits: getting up every morning, interacting with peers, and building relationships with teachers are essential skills to cultivate in young people.
sents.cn: 亲身到校有隐藏的好处：每天早起、与同伴互动、与老师建立关系，都是年轻人应培养的必备技能。

sents.en: Moreover, schools should be more than simple institutions of traditional learning.
sents.cn: 此外，学校不应只是传统学习的简单机构。

sents.en: They are now places that provide meals. They are places where students receive counseling and other support.
sents.cn: 它们如今是提供餐食的地方，是学生接受辅导与其他支持的地方。

sents.en: Those policy-makers are often fascinated by the latest technology in education and its potential to "transform" education overnight.
sents.cn: 那些政策制定者常常为教育领域的最新技术及其"一夜之间改变"教育的潜力所着迷。

sents.en: But online education does not allow a teacher to keep a struggling student after class and offer help.
sents.cn: 但在线教育无法让老师在课后留住学习困难的学生并提供帮助。

sents.en: Educational videos may deliver academic content, but they are unable to make eye contact or assess a student's level of engagement.
sents.cn: 教学视频或许能传递学术内容，却无法与学生进行眼神交流，也无法评估学生的投入程度。

sents.en: Distance education will never match the personal teaching in a traditional classroom.
sents.cn: 远程教育永远比不上传统课堂中面对面的教学。

sents.en: In their first 18 years of life, American children spend only 9% of their time in school.
sents.cn: 在美国孩子生命的前18年里，他们只在9%的时间待在学校。

sents.en: Yet teachers are expected to prepare them to be responsible citizens, cultivate their social skills, encourage efficient time management, and enhance their capacity to flourish in an increasingly harsh labor market.
sents.cn: 然而，老师却被期望将他们培养为负责任的公民，培养社交技能，鼓励高效的时间管理，并提升他们在日益严酷的劳动力市场中茁壮成长的能力。

sents.en: Given these expectations, schools should not become permanently "remote".
sents.cn: 鉴于这些期望，学校不应永久变成"远程"。

sents.en: The power of the classroom is rooted in the humanity of the people gathered in the same place, at the same time.
sents.cn: 课堂的力量根植于同一时间、同一地点汇聚之人的人性。

sents.en: Personal teaching is about teachers showing students a higher path, and about young people going through the process together.
sents.cn: 面对面教学关乎老师为学生指明更高的道路，也关乎年轻人一同经历这一过程。

sents.en: Technology, no matter how advanced, should simply be a tool of a good teacher.
sents.cn: 无论技术多先进，都只应成为好老师的一种工具。
